# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment

Iteration 1 is the verified timing-feasible incumbent at WNS 1.387 ns and WHS 0.109 ns, after recovering from the baseline’s −9.981 ns setup slack. Since the objective is `maximize_freq`, this iteration must strictly improve register-to-register setup slack over the incumbent while passing every verification and routed-metric gate. The seed’s `p0`–`p7` expressions widen both 16-bit operands to 32 bits before multiplication; the accumulator stages encode the FIR’s cycle behavior and must remain intact.

## Hypothesis

Multiplying the signed 16-bit operands directly should preserve each 32-bit product while avoiding unnecessarily wide multiplier logic, potentially improving register-to-register timing and DSP48E1 inference.

## Instruction for generator

In `fir8`, replace the sign-extended 32-bit operands in each `p0`–`p7` multiplication with the corresponding signed 16-bit `x_d * Cn` expression, keeping each product 32 bits with the same signed interpretation. Leave the `x_d`, `acc1`–`acc7`, and `y_out` registers, their synchronous reset behavior, and every accumulator update unchanged so the FIR’s cycle behavior is preserved. Keep `// @latency 1` and verify parameter behavior, simulation, setup and hold timing, and retained routed metrics; accept only if all gates pass and register-to-register setup slack strictly exceeds the incumbent’s 1.387 ns.
